[
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Ba-ta-clan: from French 'battaclan' (1820s), onomatopoeic for noisy spectacle; ba + ta + clan as syllabic reduplication",
    "reading": "A clamorous, theatrical uproar; the sound of a band striking up a comic din.",
    "languages": ["fr"],
    "source": "Littré, Dictionnaire de la langue française",
    "confidence": 0.7
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Ba (bah) + ta (ta) + clan (klan); 'ba' = barrier, 'ta' = take, 'clan' = tribe; sounds like 'bat a clan'",
    "reading": "Striking a tribe into order; a percussive call to assemble a hidden kinship.",
    "languages": ["en","fr"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Ba-ta-clan ~ Arabic 'bataq' (to beat) + 'kull' (all); or Hebrew 'bat' (daughter) + 'ta' (you) + 'klan' (sounding like 'kulan' = all of us)",
    "reading": "Daughter, you are all of us; a feminine totality hidden in the noise of the crowd.",
    "languages": ["ar","he"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Ba-ta-clan → 'can't a lab' → 'tabla can' → 'clan at ba' → 'a blank cat' (letters rearranged)",
    "reading": "A blank cat in a lab; the hidden animal of alchemy, unspeaking, yet present.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "B-T-C-L: B = birth, T = transformation, C = creation, L = light; initial letters form a hermetic sequence",
    "reading": "Birth, transformation, creation, light — the fourfold path of the green work.",
    "languages": ["la","en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "Ba (Baal, lord) + ta (Tau, cross) + clan (clan = tribe); Ba = gate, Ta = cross, Clan = family",
    "reading": "The lord's cross over the tribe; a sigil of dominion through sacrifice.",
    "languages": ["he","en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "Ba=2+1, Ta=20+1, Clan=3+12+1+14; sum = 3+21+30 = 54; 54 = 5+4 = 9; 9 = completion",
    "reading": "The sum reduces to nine, the number of initiation and the end of a cycle.",
    "languages": ["en","la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Ba (Old French 'baer' = to gape) + ta (Latin 'tacere' = to be silent) + clan (Gaelic 'clann' = offspring); gaping silence of the offspring",
    "reading": "The open-mouthed silence of a lineage; a tribe struck dumb before the spectacle.",
    "languages": ["fr","la","ga"],
    "source": "Godefroy, Dictionnaire de l'ancienne langue française",
    "confidence": 0.5
  }
]
